text: まいにち　この　じかんには　べんとうを　もって　くるのに…
note: A bento is a packed meal in a box, usually made at home and carried to work or school; a family member bringing one over is an everyday picture in Japan.
claim: A bento is a Japanese single-portion packed meal carried in a box, often prepared at home.

check.quote: A single-portion take-out or home-packed meal of Japanese origin, often for lunch, typically including rice and packaged in a box with a lid.
